newsitem.title: USA: Akzo Nobel unit sues American Home on patent.
newsitem.headline: Akzo Nobel unit sues American Home on patent.

text.p: The Intervet Inc unit of Akzo Nobel sued American Home Products Corp in a dispute over AHP's patent for a vaccine to protect dogs from coronavirus, court papers say.
An attorney for Intervet, Steven Yova told Reuters the company has been discussing a license agreement with AHP and the lawsuit is "a defensive filing."

According to papers filed Thursday in the U.S. District Court in Delaware, AHP has already sued the Upjohn Co over the same patent and has "demanded that Intervet immediately stop all manufacture...of its canine corona virus vaccine product."
The suit seeks a court order declaring the patent invalid.
An AHP spokesman told Reuters he could not comment on the Intervet lawsuit because it has not yet been served.
